source: AstraZeneca press release: Enhertu plus pertuzumab approved in the EU as first new (09-01-2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Enhertu plus pertuzumab approved in the EU as first new (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The European Commission approved AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo's Enhertu (trastuzumab deruxtecan) in combination with pertuzumab for the 1st-line treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer, following the positive CHMP opinion. The approval is based on the DESTINY-Breast09 Phase III trial (1,157 patients), in which the combination reduced the risk of disease progression or death by 44% versus THP (taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab; hazard ratio 0.56), with median PFS of 40.7 months versus 26.9 months, and no new safety concerns. The company calls it the first new 1st-line regimen in more than a decade (company claim). Daiichi Sankyo's Ken Keller: this is the second new Enhertu indication in the EU in two months, following the recent tumour-agnostic approval. Enhertu plus pertuzumab is now approved in more than 40 countries/regions for this indication. Sales of Enhertu in most EU territories are recognised by Daiichi Sankyo.
